description: A single glassmorphic form input row for the register screen: leading icon + bare TextInput + optional eye toggle + optional inline error marker. Reused for all four fields (name, email, password, confirm).

icon.description: Ionicons name for the leading glyph (person-outline, mail-outline, lock-closed-outline)

accessibilityLabel.description: Explicit SR label (placeholder alone is insufficient)

secure.description: When true, masks input and renders an eye visibility toggle

error.description: When set, renders trailing alert-circle, error border tint, and helper text below

disabled.description: Dims to 0.5 and blocks input during submit

accessibility.label: {accessibilityLabel}
accessibility.errorAnnouncement: conveyed via helper word + alert-circle icon, not color alone
